text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro Ryan was building something on the sandy beach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Put this here, and... like that!
Alright, done!
choice_data_list: Is it done? What were you making?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um, to be honest... I'm thinking of giving
Ines a flower crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since you haven't been feeling well lately...
I prayed that you'd get your energy back soon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Ines is gonna be so happy, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right...! 
I'll go call Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan, what's wrong?
You said it was an important matter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you see... I have a present for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted you to get well soon.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Hold your head high and hand it over.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not embarrassed at all.
I can just say, "Isn't this cute?")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (This place... gives me courage!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines... this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a flower crown...!
Did you make this, Ryan-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I put all my feelings into wishing
for Ines to get better soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Lupines and kalanchoes have flower meanings related to happiness... cute, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...! It's super cute!
Thank you, Ryan-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! 
And you know, that's not all—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Once Ines gets better,
I want us to explore the deserted island together... matching items and all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
S-So cuuute--!!
Hey, let's spin right now! Right this second!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If it's just walking a little bit, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see... Well then, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, look, look! A cute seashell!
I bet it'd look great on you, Ines!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I like it too, but~~
—I think it suits Ryan-chan better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...?
Then, how about making it into a brooch like this—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Look, how cute!
This one's officially chosen for Ryan-chan~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I really will make it!
Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll layer them into a flower shape.
Then again, I want to keep their original cuteness intact—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, this is completely backwards...!
I was supposed to be cheering you up!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'm getting pl~enty of it 
from Ryan-chan having such a good time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought so, you know.
Cute things really suit you, Ryan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines...! Let's look for sea glass too!
Then we can put it in bottles and give them to each other!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me!
I'll pick something super cute that suits Ryan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not gonna lose either!
I'll make you look super cute!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through her days on the deserted island,
Mejiro Ryan was definitely changing.
Seeing her growth was truly a delight!
